conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm and I want to get someone out, and I'd like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.

Comfort Club members get a waived $89 diagnostic fee on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), and priority scheduling that books members ahead of non-members, according to the Comfort Club Maintenance Plan (membership/comfort_club_overview.md).
Standard costs $189 per year or $16.99 per month for one system, and Plus is $269 per year.
